reviewer.notes: INDEPENDENT REVIEW, fresh context, did not author this unit. This row's requirement is a FIFTH MUTANT the author did not anticipate, confirmed rejected. Mutant chosen by coverage analysis of admit()'s four reject conditions: the author's four mutants exercise C1 (m4), C2 twice (m1, m2) and C3 (m3), leaving C4 -- sentinel binds to unit_id -- with ZERO coverage, because m1 deletes the sentinel and dies at C2 first while m3 rewrites the sentinel to match its own forged id. The reviewer's fifth mutant is therefore the COPY-PASTE RECEIPT: parseable, schema-valid, unit_id a real catalog unit, but the sentinel bound to a DIFFERENT real unit. Result: REJECTED on C4, 'sentinel does not embed the unit id'. Confirmed in BOTH sentinel grammars -- SENTINEL:AUD-0006:<token> and bare SUCCESS:AUD-0006 -- which matters because 1,911 of 2,007 catalogued sentinels use the bare form. Both-states control: the golden TST-0334 receipt is still ACCEPTED, so this is not a blanket-reject validator, and the shipped --self-test still exits 0 with its original 5 cases. REVIEWER-INSTRUMENT NOTE: a first attempt used sentinel 'SUCCESS:AUD-0006-uncommitted-work-census', which is not schema-valid, so it died at C2 and never reached C4 -- recorded rather than hidden; the mutant was rebuilt to be schema-valid by construction so C4 was the only condition left that could reject it.
